tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background on both screens.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: The check island, verdict card body, dashboard table, stat tiles.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Segmented-control track, row hover, flag-code chips, empty meter track.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: table row dividers, card outlines. Never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of anything you can tap or type into (inputs, secondary buttons, option chips). Holds 3:1 on surface and surface-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken and brand-soft.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (labels, legends, message numbers) on surface and surface-raised. Still at least 18px.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Harbor teal. Primary buttons, the selected segment, links and option icons; as text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of brand fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brand or brand-strong fill.

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: The reader's own message bubbles; ink text on it.

tokens.name: safe
tokens.usage: SAFE verdict fill: card band, badge. The quietest of the three verdict fills. Text on it is on-safe.

tokens.name: on-safe
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a safe fill.

tokens.name: safe-ink
tokens.usage: SAFE as text or icon on surface, surface-raised or safe-soft; the meter fill below 25.

tokens.name: safe-soft
tokens.usage: SAFE tint: stat tile, meter zone 0-24.

tokens.name: caution
tokens.usage: SUSPICIOUS verdict fill: card band, badge. Text on it is on-caution.

tokens.name: on-caution
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a caution fill.

tokens.name: caution-ink
tokens.usage: SUSPICIOUS as text or icon on surface, surface-raised or caution-soft; the meter fill at 25-49.

tokens.name: caution-soft
tokens.usage: SUSPICIOUS tint: stat tile, meter zone 25-49.

tokens.name: scam
tokens.usage: SCAM verdict fill: card band, badge. The heaviest verdict fill; differs from safe by 3:1 in lightness in both themes, so it is told apart without hue. Text on it is on-scam.

tokens.name: on-scam
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a scam fill.

tokens.name: scam-ink
tokens.usage: SCAM as text or icon on surface, surface-raised or scam-soft; the first-alert bubble border; the meter fill at 50+; file errors.

tokens.name: scam-soft
tokens.usage: SCAM tint: first-alert bubble, stat tile, meter zone 50-100.

tokens.name: flag-bg
tokens.usage: Background of a highlighted dangerous phrase in the Why view.

tokens.name: flag-line
tokens.usage: Underline and label of a highlighted dangerous phrase.

tokens.name: cat-fur
tokens.usage: The cat's cream fur. The same in every theme: she is the brand's fingerprint and never changes colour.

tokens.name: cat-outline
tokens.usage: The cat's outline, pupils, mouth and whiskers. On a dark ground the cream fur carries her shape.

tokens.name: cat-ear
tokens.usage: Inside of the cat's ears.

tokens.name: cat-eye
tokens.usage: The cat's amber eyes.

tokens.name: cat-nose
tokens.usage: The cat's nose.

tokens.name: cat-collar
tokens.usage: The cat's teal collar and shield tag, the link between her and the product.

tokens.name: cat-sign
tokens.usage: The stop sign the cat holds up on a scam. Fixed in every theme, like a real road sign.

tokens.name: cat-sign-ink
tokens.usage: The sign's white border and exclamation mark; the border separates it from a red band.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, 3px offset. A blue no verdict uses, at least 3:1 on every surface.

families.mono: "Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono", ui-monospace, "Cascadia Mono", Menlo, monospace

groups.name: Protected reader
groups.note: The grandparent screen. Nothing on it is smaller than 18px.

styles.name: verdict-title

styles.name: island-label

styles.name: warning

styles.usage: Message text in the box and in thread bubbles.

styles.name: body

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Legends, option chips, secondary buttons, badges.

groups.name: Jury dashboard
groups.note: Read from a few metres away on a projector or laptop.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: Counts in the summary above the results table.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Scenario ids, red-flag codes, scam types, scores.

tokens.name: space-1

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Phone side gutter; card body gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card and island padding.

tokens.name: space-6

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between the island and the result.

tokens.name: space-8

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Flag-code chips; the tail corner of a message bubble.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inline marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Text inputs, stat tiles, the table frame.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The open island, verdict cards, bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-pill

tokens.name: island-max
